ImageDescription.value: Horizon Flare is a very mystically written piano piece. It was used as a outro to my space themed album “Beyond Earth”, where it definitely belongs. I’m not sure whether Horizon Flare is sad, happy or hopeful. You can figure that out. People have used this piece in slow scenes with no mono- or dialogues. I would not put words over this.
